messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] No Pit values for Zero inflated Beta Binomial models
parts:
this is the call  

 model =   inla(formula,
         data=inla.stack.data(stack, spde=spde),
         Ntrials=examined,
         family="zeroinflated.betabinomial.2",
         control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack), compute=TRUE,link=1,fixed=TRUE),
         control.compute=list(cpo=TRUE, dic=TRUE,strategy='huge'),
         keep=FALSE, verbose=TRUE,
         control.mode=list(theta=theta, restart=FALSE),
         control.family=list(link = "logit",hyper=hyper),
         control.inla= list(strategy = "gaussian",
         int.strategy='ccd',
         verbose=FALSE,
         step.factor=1e-50,
         stupid.search=FALSE)
         )   


Thanks for any help,
